title: Humanize duration
skill: Give examples for the output format

good: Rewrite humanize(seconds) in humanize.py. Units: day (86400 s), hour, minute, second; days are the largest unit (no weeks or years). Show the two largest units that are not 0, joined by ", ", and skip zero units between them: 86700 -> "1 day, 5 minutes". Drop the rest, do not round: 7199 -> "1 hour, 59 minutes". One unit only if only one is not 0: 7200 -> "2 hours". Singular for 1 ("1 minute"), plural otherwise. 0 -> "0 seconds". Negative raises ValueError. Only change humanize.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Make humanize show durations more precisely.
